$comment: Esri documentation links rendered into each sidecar's 'Product documentation' section. Three parts: products (keyed by the EXACT canonical Products names) render product-level links; tools (keyed by tool name, case-insensitive) render DIRECT deep links for a doc's detected tools; searchTemplate renders a search link for any detected tool NOT in the tools map ({q} = URL-encoded tool name) — so coverage is complete on day one and any frequently-hit tool can be upgraded to a direct link by adding one line here. Edit freely: git pull deploys, and a sweep --rerank refreshes every existing sidecar. The doc.esri.com URLs were supplied/verified by the owner 2026-08-15; the esri.com overview URLs remain unverified.
